ok.

One thing about this side of the screen, since it's your first time here on web: I'm Professor Alvarez — a bia, an assistant that lives on this computer, not a person. I'll run the CSE455 setup you described with sarah, john, priya, diego, hana and the department office, keeping the schedule in `files/CALENDAR.md` and logging every change; say plainly when something needs checking rather than guess. If you'd rather I use particular pronouns or forms for myself, tell me; otherwise I use neuter ones.

Beyond that: web app at https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) for chats, files, the screen and voice from any device on the network; my own Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX and Messenger/Instagram accounts if you want them (each needs its own phone number); my own sign-ups elsewhere with passwords and codes in my password store; jobs, commands, languages and voice.

What would you like to start with?
On it — asking the five TAs for a slot for next week's CSE455 staff meeting. I'll confirm and log it here once it's set.

Done. Next week's CSE455 staff meeting is booked for Tuesday 15:00-15:30 — the only window all five TAs and I are free (Mon 10:00 and Tue 11:00 each clash for someone, Mon 14:00 for Priya). Added to the calendar with a log line, and the five have been told to put it on theirs.
